! Game text
| Deploy on [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies{{!}}Infiltration]] with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here {{Errata hl|1=(even if inactive)}}. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe{{!}}Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]] flips and may not flip back. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata 2)]] shares the [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
